6655.title: Diagnostic Claude processes reconnect to configured MCP servers
6655.rootCauseOneLine: Short-lived SDK queries inherit user MCP configuration and close after metadata or context collection, without waiting for configured MCP discovery to finish.
6655.proposedFix: Isolate metadata discovery from MCP; choose a context-reporting lifecycle that preserves MCP accounting and live-session isolation. No PR: the complete fix needs an architecture/product decision.
6655.caveats: Linux x64 with SDK-pinned Claude 2.1.245; one synthetic configured MCP server and local token-count fixture. No macOS headers helper, Keychain, fleet volume, or real billing verification. Complete source and evidence are inline per reports policy.
